answers.core: I believe such enhancement should be available without any plugin, but I understand that adding a new GIMode is a difficult decision.
answers.workaround: I think the only way to work around this enhancement is to make a plugin that defines a new lightmapper class. But this means defining a new render algorithm for a feature that should not require one.

title: Enable static meshes to participate in lightmap baking but not be mapped on texture
